message: 試される者、試す者

name: Synn
message: 「Gyaaaah!!」
Melilot's trap activates!!

name: Synn
message: 「Uggh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa... Total beatdown」

name: Synn
message: 「Grr. Guess I still have a long way to go...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well? Your power is still only at this level. Do you understand now?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's my Melilot\s04 Here, a towel」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Helena
message: 「You were going so hard you broke a sweat~」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, using traps is way too cheap」

name: Melilot
message: 「That too was all part of my strategy!」

name: Ria
message: 「You were amazing, Synn. Putting up such a good fight against Melilot of all people!」

name: Synn
message: 「I ended up losing anyway, though」

name: Ria
message: 「No, you fought all on your own today. That's huge progress!」

name: Helena
message: 「And this is just after a little coaching. He might even surpass you before long, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「R-Right. Since people call him the Demon Lord, it would be a problem if he didn't become stronger than me」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, going on the defensive now」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, pushing me this far is worthy of praise. Should the need arise, I shall lend you my aid as well」
Melilot joined the party!!

name: Synn
message: 「Me, stronger than Melilot...」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's do our best, Synn. We want to work hard right alongside you」
Our showdown with Soltia likely won't wait for us to grow stronger.
Right now, I want every bit of time I can get to grow stronger.

name: Synn
message: 「So, could you please give us just a little more time for special training?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't know what 'so' is supposed to mean, but it is already well past the time students are supposed to leave school.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know we're asking the impossible. Still--」

name: Melilot
message: 「You intend to stay the night in the library as things are. Is that what you are suggesting?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, that might actually be a great idea!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A sleepover in the library sounds like so much fun!」

name: Misa
message: 「True--」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, we're not here to play around!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「For safety management, unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering after closing hours. Students staying overnight here is completely out of the question.」

name: Helena
message: 「Then why don't you just do it at Synn-chan's house?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Melilot. I came to take you out for drinks♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Honestly... talking like that in front of the students sets a terrible example.」

name: Helena
message: 「You shouldn't treat them too much like kids. For all you know, they might actually be more mature than you are\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is that supposed to mean?」

name: Helena
message: 「The fact that you don't get it is what makes you immature.」
What are they even talking about?

name: Helena
message: 「Ria seems to go over there a lot too, so you're all hanging out together pretty often, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. If we're doing this on our own, we don't necessarily have to be in the library...」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaah, sounds so nice~~ Let me join in too~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, this isn't for fun, you know\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It isn't!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, time to head home.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, wait right there!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, you've already done plenty of solo practice up until now, haven't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, this training only really works when Melilot is there.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true, but... the all-important Melilot-san is--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm not going. I have things I need to do.」

name: Helena
message: 「I knew you'd say that♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Habo!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp!」

name: Helena
message: 「'It's on me. Keep the change.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... chugging straight from the bottle」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey, Big Sis...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ugh... guh, kyuu~~\s10」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't try this at home, kids\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you planning to kidnap her like this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Bingo♪」

name: Ria
message: 「She's completely passed out!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine. I'll wake her up with a pressure-point strike.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though she said she had things to do, what ruthless treatment...」

name: Helena
message: 「All that's left is cleaning anyway, right? If we all split up the work, it'll be done in no time. Come on, let's get started!」

name: Synn
message: 「--So, I'm the one giving her a piggyback ride?」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, you are a boy, after all\s05」
Even though she's always calling me cute, she only treats me like a guy at times like this.

name: Melilot
message: 「Hafuu~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... she reeks of booze」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Ria. What's the matter?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「Do you want a piggyback ride too, Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No I don't!!」
Giving Ria-senpai a piggyback ride, huh. She'd probably hate that in the first place.
Though if it were a piggyback, I'd kinda like to carry her... wait, no, stop that!

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, hey, Synn-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria is... pretty heavy, you know♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Sis! What are you telling Synn-kun?!\s09」

name: Helena
message: 「Nothing at all~~♪」
For her own sister to go out of her way to say something like 'heavy'...
Though personally, being a little plump like that is actually... no, cut it out!
That's only because I like Ria-senpai, not because I'm into chubby girls or anything...
Ugh... somehow, I'm getting all worked up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh... that girl」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's dangerous for a girl to be out walking alone at this hour」

name: Azel
message: 「No problem. What are you all doing, anyway」

name: Helena
message: 「We're having a sleepover at Synn-chan's house\s04 Want to come too, Azel-chan?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Zzz... zzz... pour me more--」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it, staring at me like that」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll go」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How rare for Azel to tag along」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems our friendship has finally borne fruit.」

name: Misa
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, preparations are complete. Now all that's left is to--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Munya munya... fried chicken cartilage... ♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ow! Ow! Ow!」

name: Helena
message: 「You're being way too sloppy for an elder, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That hurts, Helena! Jeez... you slipped me some medicine again, didn't you...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's an energy-boosting medicine! Come on, come on, let's get this special training started!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief... you're always so pushy...」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, Azel-san?」

name: Ria
message: 「Why did you decide to come along today?」

name: Azel
message: 「What does it matter.」

name: Ria
message: 「You always turn me down no matter what I invite you to, yet today of all days--」

name: Helena
message: 「What's the big deal? The more girls there are, the better, right? Isn't that right, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you seriously asking me that?!」

name: Azel
message: 「Exactly. There's nothing strange about it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. I'm really not thinking anything like that, okay...」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, I don't care about you anymore, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehhh~~. Why am I the one getting yelled at?!\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, youth!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, youth indeed!!」
Being with everyone is fun too, even though the person I want to be with the most is Ria-senpai.
However, right now wasn't the time to get caught up in romance.
First, I had to become a respectable Demon Lord and do something about Re-Crea.
And overcome Soltia and Virus.
And then, confess my feelings to Ria-senpai.
While I'm dragging my feet like that, Ria-senpai's graduation will be here before I know it.
We only have a few months left where we're guaranteed to spend time together.
I can't afford to take things slow.
I want to make way, way more fun memories with Ria-senpai.
And to do that, I just have to push myself even harder.

name: Melilot
message: 「That concludes this section. Have you understood everything up to this point?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, thank you for the wonderful lecture. Now, it's about time--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, let us move on to the next topic.」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaah! Come on, let's call it a night already, Melilot!」

name: Melilot
message: 「The night is still young, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Fine! I invoke my ultimate Chairwoman authority!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, we are currently on the Sakura family grounds. Authority here rests with Sakura-kun.」

name: Helena
message: 「Tch」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me. Could we... keep going for just a little longer?」

name: Helena
message: 「No, absolutely not. If you cram too hard like that, you'll just forget everything you worked so hard to learn earlier, won't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「There's no need to rush. Chew on it slowly and let it sink in. Scarfing things down doesn't give you any nutrition, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis. You're making it sound all reasonable, but you really just want to hurry up and go play, don't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Eek」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you're just as bad, Synn―kun. You're already exhausted every day from special training and preparing for the Holy Night Festival, right? If you push yourself on top of that―」
The only reason I want to push myself is so I can stay with Ria-senpai even a little longer...
W-what am I thinking, that's so embarrassing!

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-you're right! There's always tomorrow, after all.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yeehaw!! Then let's get this drinking party started right away!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! A whole feast has appeared out of nowhere!」

name: Helena
message: 「Just now, I went 'chop-chop-chop, ta-da!' you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amazing. Synn's kitchen is hard to use if you're not used to it」

name: Ria
message: 「I've used it a little bit before, so I pretty much... you know」
When did Helena-san ever use my kitchen?

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, smells good!! Count me in too~~」

name: Helena
message: 「Yeah, yeah, eat up! Drink up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis. No alcohol, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm fine!! I'm naturally high after all!!」
How did that end up turning into this?

name: Helena
message: 「Graaah, drink uuuup. Guhehehehe」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I can't drink any more cola... zzz」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No more milk... zzz...」

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz... Paqy-san\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ugh... ughh... I'm gonna die...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Phew... Alcohol or not, Helena sure is a wild one, isn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「You change a whole lot when you get alcohol in you too, though, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Please, I must ask that you keep that strictly to yourself. Understood?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, I shall return to the library. Please take good care of Helena and everyone else」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much for today」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, excuse me」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey. Was it bad that I just heard that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Keep it a secret」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. I promise I'll only tell the Boss」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, it's a secret!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Aaaah----」
They left.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever」

name: Ria
message: 「What's 'whatever'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Ria-senpai......」

name: Ria
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No...... it's just that you're always----」

name: Ria
message: 「Surprised I'm still awake since I'm always the first one to go to sleep?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's not......」

name: Ria
message: 「It's written all over your face. Totally busted♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Wanna step outside for a bit?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, over here, over here」
At her invitation, I sit down next to Ria-senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Look, look, look~~♪」
I followed her slender, pale fingertips with my eyes.

name: Ria
message: 「It's amazing again tonight~~」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is」

name: Ria
message: 「This might be the first time in my life I've seen them falling like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too. Usually they disappear as soon as you blink」

name: Ria
message: 「Because the next shooting star comes right after, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder if the last Re-Crea had something like this happen too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, about the previous Re-Crea. Do you know something about it?」

name: Ria
message: 「It was before even my big sister was born, so it's a story I heard from Mother, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that's when you heard about the Demon King?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. After hearing Mother's stories about the Demon King she saw, my big sister and I always admired him」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if the Demon King Ria-senpai's mother saw was my dad」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe so」

name: Synn
message: 「Please tell me a little more about that story」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure. If I remember right, when Mother was in a pinch, the Demon King came to rescue her」

name: Ria
message: 「And it sounds like her heart started fluttering right then and there\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~~」

name: Ria
message: 「When she asked him to help exterminate the demons together, he gladly agreed, she said」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad really does act without thinking about the consequences」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... Aren't you the exact same way, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Ria
message: 「And then, you know, people with the same goal started showing up one after another in Ryuusei Town--」

name: Synn
message: 「Those people gathered to form the Crusaders, and the previous Re-Crea passed without incident」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. But after everything was over, e~veryone disappeared, she said」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? D-Don't tell me, an honorable...」

name: Ria
message: 「They're alive, they're alive\s02 Otherwise, we wouldn't have been born\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「So everyone just went back to their own lives」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... Unfortunately, Mother's first love never bore fruit, though\s07」
The Crusaders are an organization gathered only during a Re-Crea emergency.
Once this Re-Crea passes, the Crusaders will disband.
Comrades sharing the same purpose will never gather again. Nor will we share the same joys.
Nor will we overcome the same hardships together.
Even though we'll be freed from all the pain, why does it make me feel so heartbroken?
It's because it means parting ways with Ria-senpai.
Because the person who was always by my side will no longer be there.
Even though I know I really shouldn't be thinking about things like this.
There are times when I wish Re-Crea would just keep going forever.
I don't want to leave……
Even if everything comes to an end, I want to stay together with Ria-senpai……

name: Ria
message: 「First love…… huh……」

name: Ria
message: 「It's the same for me…… maybe……」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!? W-what do you mean by that?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's……」

name: Synn
message: 「……Gulp」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee…… It's a secret……」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeeh--」

name: Ria
message: 「……Zzz…… zzz……」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh?」
She fell asleep. Was she forcing herself to stay awake after all?
Cutting off right at the crucial part--there's a limit to how much you can tease someone.
Still, when it comes to Ria-senpai's first love, I pretty much know who it is.
It's the Demon King.
So what does it mean that it didn't work out?
Is it her roundabout way of saying things won't work out with me?
Aaah……
Even so, I feel like it's still too soon to give up.
Just a little more. It's only for a little while longer, after all. Because I get to be with Ria-senpai.
I can't lose to some Demon King she admires.
Wait, I'm the Demon King, and who's the Demon King? Who is Ria-senpai actually referring to when she says Demon King?
Huh……?
Alright! Now I'm completely lost.

name: Synn
message: 「She'll catch a cold if I leave her like this」
I went to lift Ria-senpai up.
Now then.
Should I give her a piggyback ride or carry her in my arms?
After agonizing over it――

name: Synn
message: 「……Hup」
Since it's too embarrassing after all, I went with a princess carry.
With a piggyback, Ria-senpai would be pressed way too close against me and it'd get embarrassing. Mainly her chest.
This way, Ria-senpai is the one who'd be embarrassed instead.
Though, with my arms wedged between her thighs and calves, and being able to feel the ridge of her bra through her back, this position isn't exactly easy to underestimate either.
Thinking about what would happen if I accidentally unfastened the hook--no, stop it, stop it!

name: Ria
message: 「Zzz... zzz... mnh, mnh」
What an innocent sleeping face. It almost makes me forget she's older than me and my upperclassman.
If she puts her palm against my chest like that, she's going to find out how fast my heart is pounding!
Well, if you hold the girl you like and your heart doesn't race, you're a weirdo.
However--

name: Synn
message: 「H-Heavy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「……Zzz…… zzz……」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa... That was close, that was close」
Still, I'm a guy too.

name: Synn
message: 「Heave-ho!」
If I can't even carry the person I love, how am I supposed to be in a relationship?
